title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions Across the Evidence Boundaries of Hybrid Quantum-Classical Kernel Workflows
description: Version 1.2.0 reproducibility artifact: code, tests, compact derived evidence (frozen 1.0.0 gates, the preregistered 1.1.0 reinforcement gates and the preregistered 1.2.0 policy gates: family-wise regime calibration and end-to-end allow/hold/block evaluation on frozen outputs), figures, six SHA-256 evidence manifests, formal core, adversary model and manuscript sources. No kernel, model or draw was re-executed with respect to 1.1.1; the 1.0.0 evidence tables are byte-identical except for repository-relative paths in the two gate-completeness tables.
